title: live_tx receiver-drop break only covers close_after_first path
description: The new is_err() break on live_tx.send(None) in the close_after_first + empty-batch path (line 365) correctly stops the task when the client disconnects. However the analogous live_tx.send(Some(...)) call at line 391 already handled this with its own is_err() break. The two send sites now have matching error-handling shapes. The concern is that the close_after_first=false path with an empty batch still loops without attempting any send, so receiver-drop is not detected until the next non-empty batch or recv() closes -- that is correct behavior but undocumented. No functional bug; the fix is complete but the asymmetry in how quickly disconnection is detected across the two paths is worth noting.
